mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.combo_model_id, s.athlete_id, s.trigger_result_id, s.combo_score, s.ref_snapshot, s.algo_version, s.calculated_at, a.name AS athlete_name, d.dept_name AS athlete_team, cm.formula AS combo_model_name FROM apms_combo_score s LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON s.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN apms_combo_model cm ON s.combo_model_id = cm.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_combo_score (combo_model_id, athlete_id, trigger_result_id, combo_score, ref_snapshot, algo_version, calculated_at) VALUES (#{comboModelId}, #{athleteId}, #{triggerResultId}, #{comboScore}, #{refSnapshot}, #{algoVersion}, IFNULL(#{calculatedAt}, sysdate()))
